etymologies.etymologyHTML: From manage +‎ -er.

definitions.definition: (management) A person whose job is to manage something, such as a business, a restaurant, or a sports team.

quote.text: And it was a fitting victory for Liverpool as Anfield celebrated the 100th anniversary of the birth of their legendary Scottish manager Bill Shankly.

definitions.definition: (music) An administrator, for a singer or group. (Can we add an example for this sense?)
(software) A window or application whose purpose is to give the user the control over some aspect of the system.
